_doc: Build-quality benchmark prompts: what a public user would type into the Atech Atelier chat.
Every expectation is machine-checked by fc_build.py against the MEASURED geometry, never the agent's prose.
Always checked (not listed per prompt): model.py written, build succeeds, every end object isValid() and has >=1 solid.
Dimensions: 'max_dim' is the largest side of the whole design's tight bound (Shape.optimalBoundingBox).
'any_dims': each [lo,hi] must be matched by a DISTINCT side of the whole-design bound (orientation-free).
'object_dims': at least one single object whose sides, sorted largest first, fall in these ranges.
'holes': full concave cylinders (summed arc >= 330 deg, grouped by axis+radius) - a bore or drilled hole, not a fillet.
'bores' / 'bore_d' / 'min_bores': as holes but summed arc >= 240 deg, so a C-shaped channel (cable clip) counts.
'hole_d': only holes with diameter in [lo,hi] count toward 'min_holes'.
'max_fill_ratio': volume / tight-bound volume of the largest object - proves a hollow/pocketed object is not a solid block.
'min_aspect': largest / smallest side of the whole-design bound.
'single_solid_per_object': every end object is exactly one solid (printable as one body).

FITNESS keys (S15; reported separately from the expectation checks, so the pass score stays comparable): 'gear_teeth' (teeth counted on the mid-height section), 'on_desk', 'allow_overlap', 'atech_check'. no_overlap runs on every prompt.

prompts.prompt: headphone hook that clamps a 25mm desk
